data.name: The Blighted Frontier
data.detailed_description:
The world didn't end it became blighted. 

humanity clings to survival in a land overrun. The dead wander, The living struggle. And every decision you make determines whether your settlement thrives… or collapses.

You begin with only a handful of survivors and a broken down RV in an unforgiving wilderness. What starts as a makeshift camp must become something more.

Shelter must be built, food must be secured, and order must be established in a world where chaos is the natural state. Every structure you place, every resource you gather, and every decision you make shapes the future of your settlement.

BUILD YOUR SETTLEMENT

Begin with a small encampment and grow it into a fully functioning settlement.

  • Construct homes, workshops, and defenses

  • Upgrade buildings through multiple tiers

  • Design efficient layouts for survival and production

  • Expand outward into dangerous, resource-rich territory

Your people are the heart of your settlement. They are not just workers, but individuals struggling to survive. They grow, specialize, and adapt based on the task you assign them. A skilled hunter can mean the difference between starvation and survival. A dedicated builder can turn weak defenses into a fortified stronghold. But they are also vulnerable. Fatigue, hunger, and fear can break them just as easily as the threats outside your walls.

MANAGE YOUR SURVIORS

Your people are more than workers—they’re survivors.

  • Assign task (Build, Hunt, Farm, Cook, Scavenge, etc.)

  • Manage needs: hunger, health, morale

  • Develop skills and specialization over time

  • Balance productivity with survival

As your settlement grows, so do its demands. Simple gathering turns into complex production chains. Raw materials must be refined, tools must be crafted, and systems must be built to sustain a growing population. Traders may arrive with opportunities, offering rare goods and new paths forward, but relying on the outside world is never without risk.

UPGRADE YOUR SETTLEMENT

A thriving settlement depends on smart production.

  • Gather, refine, and craft essential resources

  • Trade with traveling merchants

  • Unlock new technologies and upgrades

Defense is not optional, It is survival. As your presence grows, so does the attention you attract. You will need to fortify your settlement, arm your survivors, and prepare for the inevitable. When the walls are tested, it is not just your structures at risk it is the community you have built.

DEFEND AGAINST THE BLIGHT

The world is not empty—and it wants you gone.

  • Defend against waves of infected and hostile threats

  • Build walls, traps, and fortified structures

  • Equip survivors with weapons and gear

  • Prepare for unpredictable disasters

There is no single path forward. Every playthrough tells a different story shaped by your choices, your priorities, and your ability to adapt. Some settlements will flourish, becoming symbols of resilience in a broken world. Others will fall, swallowed by the same blight that claimed everything before them.

In the end, The Blighted Frontier is not just about survival. It is about rebuilding something worth protecting in a world that has already been lost.

The question is not whether the world can be saved.

It’s whether your people can endure.

data.short_description: Rebuild civilization in a world consumed by the blight. Manage survivors, defend against the dead, and transform a fragile camp into a thriving frontier settlement.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K / i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 XT
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
